title: 第25章 这还打个头啊第26章 想吃席吗这么慢
content_zh:
李易闻言，这才从战利品中挑出几根品质不错的‘脊骨’和些许材料，拿到楚墨面前递出：
“这位师弟，这是你应得的一份。”
“呵呵，有劳。”楚墨接过东西，皮笑肉不笑的说道。
这些‘脊骨’本就是他亲手击杀所得，若自己方才拒绝加入，对方是否就想仗着人多强行吞没？
他目光扫过笑呵呵的赢乐，在心中给此人贴上了“需加强提防”的标签。若非现在人多眼杂，自己不好下手.....
‘想来也是，此人当初选的功法是《玄蛇蜕真心经》，若无炉鼎辅助，进境绝难如此迅猛。’
楚墨眸光幽幽，以己推人，赢乐能在短短三月内突破炼气三层，背后若没有些说道，有谁会信？
赢乐不知楚墨心中所想，依旧热情地拉着他，介绍队伍中的几位核心人物。
“这位是伊师兄，符箓大家；这位徐师兄，剑术超群；这位是...”
楚墨默默听着，大多人实力与他相仿，仅有一件寻常法器傍身，并无甚出奇之处。
唯有一位名叫绮罗霜的女修引起他的注意。
眸清似水，颜若芙蓉，一袭墨兰素锦勾勒出玲珑身，端的是风姿绰约。
但吸引楚墨的并非其容貌，而是此女的打扮：
脚下素靴、腰间玉珏、腕上紫镯以及头上金钗，竟都氤氲灵光，无一不是品质上佳的法器。
‘嘶’楚墨倒吸一口凉气，这女子什么来历，一身行头堪称移动宝库。没记错的话，方才混战中，对方还信手撒出一把上品灵符。
原本以为自己身怀两件上品法器已算身家丰厚，没想到还有高手。
赢乐用肩膀轻撞了一下楚墨，挤眉弄眼道：“楚兄盯了这般久，莫非是对绮仙子有意？”
楚墨回过神，从金钗法器上偏开视线，淡然道：“赢兄说笑了。”
“嘿嘿，明白明白，窈窕淑女，君子好逑。”赢乐露出一副“我懂”的神情，随即压低声音，神秘兮兮地提醒：
“不过绮仙子背景深厚，绝非你我能够招惹的。”

‘你明白个锤子。’楚墨心中腹诽，懒得与他争辩，自顾寻了处干净地面打坐调息。赢乐见调侃无趣，便转身与李易商议后续行动。
休整约莫半个时辰后，队伍再次开拔。沿途遭遇的土著部落一触即溃，残兵败将纷纷遁入浓雾。
连番胜利让众人士气高涨，狂热地向隐雾谷中心推进。连楚墨也不免被这氛围带动，出手愈发凌厉。
途中不断有零散弟子汇入，队伍规模如同滚雪球般膨胀。三日后抵达目的地时，人数已逾半百之众。
......
“轰！”
炽热的火球轰然炸开，将最后一道障碍连同稀薄的雾气一同轰散。
一座巍峨祭坛的全貌，豁然呈现在众人眼前！
祭坛依傍陡峭山壁开凿而成，巍然矗立于谷地最核心处，通体遍布血红的诡异纹路，散发出不祥的气息。
“那是什么？！”队伍中有人惊呼出声。
content_en:
After hearing this, Li Yi picked out a few good-quality 'spines' and some materials from the trophies, and handed them over to Chu Mo:
"Junior brother, this is what you deserve."
"Haha, thank you." Chu Mo took the things and said with a smile.
These 'spines' were originally obtained by killing him with his own hands. If he had just refused to join, would the other party want to engulf them by force based on the number of people?
He glanced at the smiling Ying Le, and mentally labeled this person as "need to be more careful". If there weren't so many people out there now, I wouldn't be able to do anything...
'Thinking about it, the technique this person originally chose was the "Mysterious Snake Sloughing True Heart Sutra". Without the help of the cauldron, it would have been impossible to advance so quickly. ’
Chu Mo's eyes were dim and he judged others by his own example. Ying Le was able to break through the third level of Qi Refining in just three months. If there wasn't some words behind him, who would believe it?
Ying Le didn't know what Chu Mo was thinking, but still enthusiastically pulled him and introduced several core figures in the team.
"This is Senior Brother Yi, Master Fulu; this Senior Brother Xu has excellent swordsmanship; this is..."
Chu Mo listened silently. Most of the people were similar in strength to him. They only had an ordinary magic weapon at their side, and there was nothing surprising about it.
Only a female cultivator named Qi Luoshuang caught his attention.
Her eyes are as clear as water, her face is like a hibiscus, and she is dressed in ink orchid and plain brocade, outlining her exquisite figure, showing her grace and grace.
But what attracted Chu Mo was not her appearance, but the way she dressed:
The plain boots on his feet, the jade bracelet on his waist, the purple bracelets on his wrists, and the golden hairpin on his head were all filled with aura, and they were all high-quality magical artifacts.
‘Hiss’ Chu Mo took a breath, what is the origin of this woman, her outfit is a mobile treasure trove. If I remember correctly, in the melee just now, the opponent casually threw out a handful of high-grade spiritual talismans.
I originally thought that I was rich because I had two high-grade magic weapons, but I didn't expect that there were masters.
Ying Le bumped Chu Mo lightly with his shoulder, winked and said, "Brother Chu has been staring at her for so long. Could it be that he is interested in Fairy Qi?"
Chu Mo came back to his senses, looked away from the golden hairpin magic weapon, and said calmly: "Brother Ying was joking."
"Hey, I understand, my fair lady, a gentleman is so stubborn." Ying Le showed an "I understand" look, then lowered his voice and reminded mysteriously:
"But Fairy Qi has a profound background and is definitely not something you and I can offend."
‘You know a hammer. ’ Chu Mo cursed in his heart and was too lazy to argue with him, so he found a clean place to meditate and adjust his breath. Seeing that the teasing was boring, Ying Le turned around to discuss the follow-up actions with Li Yi.
After resting for about half an hour, the team set off again. The indigenous tribes encountered along the way collapsed at the first touch, and the remaining defeated soldiers fled into the thick fog one after another.
Successive victories boosted everyone's morale, and they pushed feverishly towards the center of Hidden Mist Valley. Even Chu Mo couldn't help but be inspired by this atmosphere, and his attacks became more and more fierce.
Scattered disciples continued to join in along the way, and the size of the team expanded like a snowball. When they arrived at their destination three days later, there were already more than half a hundred people.
...
"Boom!"
The blazing fireball exploded, blasting away the last obstacle along with the thin mist.
The whole picture of a towering altar suddenly appeared before everyone's eyes!
The altar was carved out of the steep mountain wall and stood majestically at the core of the valley. It was covered with strange blood-red lines and exuded an ominous aura.
"What is that?!" someone in the team exclaimed.
